import sys

def str_to_int_arr(s):
    s_arr = s.split()
    return [int(x) for x in s_arr]

class Cutting:
    def check_sub(self, a_arr, split_ind):
        n_even = 0
        n_odd = 0
        for i in range(split_ind + 1):
            el = a_arr[i]
            if el % 2 == 0:
                n_even += 1
            else:
                n_odd += 1
        return n_even == n_odd

    def get_max_cuts(self, n, b, a_arr):
        candidates = []
        for i in range(1, len(a_arr) - 1):
            if self.check_sub(a_arr, i):
                candidates.append(i)
        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: (abs(a_arr[x] - a_arr[x + 1]), x))
        n_coins = b
        n_cuts = 0
        for idx in candidates:
            if n_coins <= 0:
                break
            cost = abs(a_arr[idx] - a_arr[idx + 1])
            if cost >= (n_coins + 1):
                break
            n_coins -= cost
            n_cuts += 1
        return n_cuts

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    nb_ln = data[0].strip()
    a_ln = data[1].strip()
    nb_arr = str_to_int_arr(nb_ln)
    a_arr = str_to_int_arr(a_ln)
    cut = Cutting()
    n = nb_arr[0]
    b = nb_arr[1]
    max_c = cut.get_max_cuts(n, b, a_arr)
    sys.stdout.write(str(max_c) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
